title: Kissed-by-smoke Slovakian bitter Bowl
description: A refreshing Slovakian dish featuring glassy-jelly texture, lime juice, and wood-fired-bake, perfect for brunch.

ingredients.name: Wood-Fired Roasted Carrots
ingredients.notes: Roasted with garlic, salt, and pepper

ingredients.name: Wood-Fired Sliced Beets
ingredients.notes: Roasted with thyme, salt, and pepper

instructions: Roast the carrots and beets in the wood-fired oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
Toast the wood-fired sourdough bread in the wood-fired oven for 2-3 minutes, or until crispy.
Arrange the roasted carrots and beets in the dolsot stone bowl.
Drizzle the lime juice over the top of the carrots and beets.
Sprinkle the fresh dill and coarse black pepper over the top.
If using, drizzle the honey over the top.
Serve the wood-fired sourdough bread on the side.
Drizzle the extra virgin olive oil over the top of the entire dish for serving.
